title: Split Rogue Thieves' Cant into its own level-1 feature
description: Deficiency #2 — real extraction/modeling defect. Thieves' Cant prose is currently embedded inside feature:rogue:sneak-attack; PR #336 found Rogue level 1 has a 'Thieves Cant' progression marker with no frozen feature record. Fix in the importer: emit feature:rogue:thieves-cant as its own level-1 Rogue feature, remove that prose from Sneak Attack, and make Rogue level-1 progression grant BOTH Sneak Attack and Thieves' Cant. Audit gate: missing feature headings (Rogue Thieves' Cant-style) fail the re-audit.
notes:
FOLDED INTO eshyra-o9bd.2 (2026-06-28): Rogue L1 'Thieves Cant' has no feature record, so .2 cannot type that progression row without it. Rather than a 2nd frozen-pack regeneration, .2 creates feature:rogue:thieves-cant, de-embeds its prose from feature:rogue:sneak-attack, and grants both at L1 as featureGrants. Will close as absorbed when .2 lands.
